candidates.title: Six-Year-Old Girl Assaulted, Killed in Prakasam; Accused Held
candidates.excerpt: According to reports, the accused took the girl, who was sleeping outdoors near her house, sexually assaulted her and killed her. He placed her body on a chair near the house before fleeing the scene.

candidates.title: BJP files police complaint against Kharge over 'baap' remark targeting PM Modi
candidates.excerpt: Bharatiya Janata Party has lodged a police complaint against Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge in Patna. The complaint relates to Kharge's remarks about Prime Minister Modi during an event during 139th birth anniversary Bihar's first CM, Shrikrishna Singh. Krishna Kumar Singh, a BJP worker, demands an apology from Kharge within 24 hours. The initial report was filed at Kotwali police station, then transferred to Gandhi Maidan.

candidates.title: Yellow alert for 2 Andhra districts today, red alert on Oct 27-28 amid Cyclone Arnab
candidates.excerpt: The India Meteorological Department has issued a red alert for extremely heavy rainfall on October 27. Several districts including Kakinada and East Godavari are expected to experience this severe weather. An orange alert has been announced for other districts, indicating heavy to very heavy rainfall. Yellow warnings for heavy rainfall have been issued for additional areas like Palnadu and Prakasam.

candidates.title: Cheetahs kill two calves near house in MP village, spark panic among residents
candidates.excerpt: Two cheetahs killed two cattle calves near a house in Madhya Pradesh’s Sheopur district, triggering concern among villagers working in fields at night. Kuno National Park officials urged residents not to panic and report sightings, assuring compensation for livestock losses

candidates.title: Two dead as building slabs collapse in Delhi’s Harsh Vihar
candidates.excerpt: Two people died after building slabs collapsed during construction at Milan Garden in Delhi’s Harsh Vihar area. Rescue teams from Delhi Police, Fire Service, NDRF and Civil Defence cleared debris, while ministers Kapil Mishra and Ashish Sood visited the site
